description: All informational/status overlays on the graph (edge count warning, loading/refreshing indicator, graph-unavailable messages) should be visually centered in the graph area, matching the focus lens empty-state pattern. Additionally, the high edge count warning should include a 'Show anyway' button that lets users bypass the performance warning and render the graph regardless.
name: center-graph-informational-overlays-and-add-show-anyway-override-for-edge-warning
title: Center graph informational overlays and add 'Show anyway' override for edge warning
